title: What Your Lungs Do After Your Last Cigarette
description:
The day you stop smoking, your body starts clearing out the toxins. Within days or weeks you start to breathe more easily, your circulation improves, and after 1 year your risk of heart attack halves compared to a smoker's.

Educational only. Not medical advice. The NHS offers free support to quit smoking.
